action.sql: SELECT 'cancel' t, date_trunc('month', CAST(ts AS DATE)) m, count(*) n FROM order_cancellation GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'refund', date_trunc('month', CAST(ts AS DATE)), count(*) FROM refund GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'complaint', date_trunc('month', CAST(ts AS DATE)), count(*) FROM complaint GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
